text_ru: Утечка продуктов{place}: {amount} т. Перевезите продукты под охрану.
context: Строка в списке ламп о потерях продуктов из хранилищ, где нельзя поставить сторожа. Показывает массу потерь в тоннах; если место известно, готовая фраза называет его. Затем предлагает перевезти продукты в охраняемое хранилище. Это хозяйственное предупреждение, не обвинение человека и не предупреждение о суде.
meaning: Food was lost from stores that cannot be guarded; the event supplies a loss amount and the store with the greatest loss
intent: Show the measured loss and the largest-loss location, then name moving food under guard as the existing lever
keep: No named culprit, audit or trial threat; do not suggest posting a guard at the church or clamp; place is a ready phrase or empty, never a bare nominative label
binding_note: Supersedes the original tons/nominative-place contract under boss-rpg-unguarded-leak-shape-2026-11-07 [1] and the feed namespace note. feed_amount_unit=tonnes on the design feed row; host formats amount from event grams as tonnes once, without a weight suffix because the source supplies т. No second conversion in UI. place is the existing host ready phrase including its leading space and preposition, e.g. <space>из церкви or <space>из бурта у <inflected field name>, or empty. Do not add punctuation, spacing or prepositions around it in code. unit/resource are event selection inputs, not additional string placeholders; do not identify all loss as the resource with the largest loss. Boss registers/imports via sync/save/check/export; UE binds the existing feed row to the lamp list. No new interval, culprit, alarm enum or button.
